; Page tint: a see-through yellow layer over the interface, controlled by a
; vertical slider in quick settings, next to the front-light slider.
; Tap the slider's icon to switch the tint off or back to its last level.
; The level (layer opacity) is saved in /home/root/.config/page-tint.
;
; Requires: qt-command-executor

AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Rectangle {
                id: pageTintOverlay
                objectName: "pageTintOverlay"
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 100000
                enabled: false
                color: "#FFB000"
                property real level: 0
                opacity: level
                visible: level > 0

                CommandExecutor {
                    id: pageTintOverlayExec
                }

                Component.onCompleted: {
                    var r = pageTintOverlayExec.executeCommand("/bin/sh", ["-c", "cat /home/root/.config/page-tint 2>/dev/null"]);
                    if (typeof r === "string") {
                        r = JSON.parse(r);
                    }
                    var saved = parseFloat(r.stdout);
                    if (!isNaN(saved)) {
                        level = saved;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/QuickSettingsWindow.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#_columnRow
        LOCATE AFTER Repeater
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.Slider {
                id: pageTintSlider
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignRight | Qt.AlignTop

                // Slider runs 0-100; full scale is this much layer opacity.
                readonly property real maxOpacity: 0.3
                property real tint: 0
                property real previousTint: 60
                property var overlay: null

                orientation: Qt.Vertical
                showDividers: true
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/highlighter"
                from: 0
                to: 100
                steps: 5
                value: pageTintSlider.tint

                CommandExecutor {
                    id: pageTintExec
                }

                function run(cmd) {
                    var r = pageTintExec.executeCommand("/bin/sh", ["-c", "unset NOTIFY_SOCKET; " + cmd]);
                    if (typeof r === "string") {
                        r = JSON.parse(r);
                    }
                    return r;
                }

                function findOverlay(item) {
                    if (!item) {
                        return null;
                    }
                    if (item.objectName === "pageTintOverlay") {
                        return item;
                    }
                    var kids = item.children;
                    for (var i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
                        var found = findOverlay(kids[i]);
                        if (found) {
                            return found;
                        }
                    }
                    return null;
                }

                function setTint(v) {
                    tint = v;
                    var opacity = (v / 100 * maxOpacity).toFixed(3);
                    run("mkdir -p /home/root/.config && echo " + opacity + " > /home/root/.config/page-tint");
                    if (!overlay) {
                        var top = pageTintSlider;
                        while (top.parent) {
                            top = top.parent;
                        }
                        overlay = findOverlay(top);
                    }
                    if (overlay) {
                        overlay.level = parseFloat(opacity);
                    } else {
                        console.log("page-tint: overlay not found");
                    }
                }

                updateValue: (v) => {
                    pageTintSlider.setTint(v);
                }

                onClicked: {
                    if (tint > 0) {
                        previousTint = tint;
                        setTint(0);
                    } else {
                        setTint(previousTint > 0 ? previousTint : 60);
                    }
                }

                // A keyboard backlight slider (for reMarkable's Type Folio) appears
                // whenever any keyboard is connected. Other keyboards have no
                // backlight, so it is just an empty column: hide it, leaving the
                // two sliders. Widgets load asynchronously, so check a few times.
                function hideEmptySiblings() {
                    var row = pageTintSlider.parent;
                    if (!row) {
                        return;
                    }
                    for (var i = 0; i < row.children.length; i++) {
                        var c = row.children[i];
                        if (c.item && String(c.item).indexOf("KeyboardQuickSettingsSlider") === 0) {
                            c.visible = false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Timer {
                    id: pageTintLayoutFix
                    interval: 50
                    repeat: true
                    running: true
                    property int ticks: 0
                    onTriggered: {
                        pageTintSlider.hideEmptySiblings();
                        if (++ticks >= 10) {
                            running = false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                Component.onCompleted: {
                    hideEmptySiblings();
                    var saved = parseFloat(run("cat /home/root/.config/page-tint 2>/dev/null").stdout);
                    if (!isNaN(saved)) {
                        tint = Math.min(100, Math.round(saved / maxOpacity * 5) * 20);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
